project_type: Python monorepo (jarvis-shared, jarvis-backend, jarvis-local-agent) + vanilla-JS dashboard with NO build step (browser loads ES modules directly)
language: Python 3.10+ and browser vanilla JavaScript (ES modules)
build_system: No JS build/bundler. Python packages are editable installs. The repo-root .venv has pytest but NO pip and NO ruff.
build_command: none for JS; Python is interpreted
test_command: set JARVIS_ENV=dev then: .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest tests/unit tests/integration -q
verification_instructions: Run the Python suite with JARVIS_ENV=dev; baseline GREEN is 313 passed, 9 skipped (the 9 skips are optional postgres pgserver tests). For JS: `node` is NOT on PATH in this environment, so there is no node --check. Verify JS by careful review: it must use ONLY el()/textContent from dom.js (NO innerHTML), add nothing inline (no inline <script>, no inline style string that violates CSP), and the SpeechRecognition-absent path (e.g. Firefox) must disable the mic button and never throw.
snapshot_or_generated_files: null — no generated/snapshot files are checked in for this task.
environment_constraints: node is unavailable (JS = review only). The repo-root .venv CAN import vosk and sounddevice, but voice_local.py imports them LAZILY inside methods, so module import must stay side-effect free — preserve that. Tests needing vosk at import must guard with pytest.importorskip. Lint tools (ruff) are not installed; match surrounding per-file style for lint-cleanliness. Python 3.10 compat required.
contribution_requirements: Do NOT change the /api/assist contract, the supervisor, the policy gate, the local validator, or auth/MFA. No CSP changes, no inline script/style, no innerHTML, no CDN/third-party JS — Web Speech API (window.SpeechRecognition / window.speechSynthesis) only. Keep single-MicStream ownership and the wake-word energy gate. Graceful degradation everywhere. Use original synthetic voices; never imitate real actors.
key_patterns: DOM is built via el(tag, props, ...children) from web/js/dom.js; `el` supports class/text/on<Event>/style(per-property CSSOM writes, CSP-safe)/attributes; clear(node, ...children) replaces children; toast(message, kind) shows transient status. voice.js mountOverview already has: a text input (maxLength 500), a Send button wired to send(), send() POSTs api('/api/assist',{method:'POST',body:{session_id:'dashboard',utterance:text}}), setState(name,sub,mode) drives the stage UI, and it already calls speakPreview(r.speech, v) (v = voices[r.responding_agent]) imported from ./agents.js — so the reply is ALREADY spoken; the task ADDS speech INPUT. agents.js speakPreview(text, voice) already sets utterance.lang = voice.language || 'en-US' and clamps pitch/rate; it must gain an optional language override + matching-voice selection WITHOUT breaking per-agent pitch/rate. RuntimeConfig (config.py) is a pydantic BaseSettings, env_prefix JARVIS_, env_file .env, flat fields with inline defaults (e.g. wake_phrase: str = 'hey jarvis'); add fields in that same style. voice_local.get_model() currently does vosk.Model(lang='en-us') under a module lock; VoskWakeWordEngine._grammar() hardcodes ['hey jarvis','jarvis','[unk]'] and must instead derive tokens from the configured wake_phrase (keep '[unk]'); _matches() + energy gate (min_level) stay. SapiTTSProvider.__init__ picks david(male)/zira(female) from SAPI voices; add an optional voice_hint preference with English fallback; keep VOICE_MAP rate/volume. voice_app.VoiceApp._arun builds VoskWakeWordEngine/VoskSTTProvider/SapiTTSProvider and loads the model — thread new config here; keep RuntimeConfig.load() and the single self.mic MicStream.
test_pattern: Local-agent launcher tests (tests/unit/test_launchers.py) inspect source via ast/text. RuntimeConfig construction in tests passes _env_file=None and explicit fields (see tests/unit/test_local_security.py: RuntimeConfig(backend_url=..., _env_file=None)) and uses monkeypatch.setenv for env-driven assertions. Put new tests in tests/unit/test_voice_config.py and guard any vosk-at-import path with pytest.importorskip('vosk').
